_about: The use-case suite's assistants (EVAL-USECASES.md §1). Each is set up from its T1 template on its real site, as an invited owner would: template + setup answers (written from the site), the builder's questions, the recommended purpose, the checkup, publish. `pack` is the pack the assistant must end on (never weaker). `access` is the local bot page's; the production rounds (blocks 1.3, 1.5) use invite-only pages.

answers.helpline: 9152987821, Monday to Saturday, 8 am to 9 pm. Email icall@tiss.ac.in (we reply within 24 hours).
answers.on_a_call: A trained counsellor with a Master's in clinical or counselling psychology picks up. It's free (you pay only your call charges) and anonymous: you don't have to give your name.
answers.not_covered: No face-to-face counselling, no psychiatrist or medication advice, no financial aid and no call-backs, except in an emergency. We refer people to professionals and organisations from our referral directory.

answers.services: Home-based palliative care for people with advanced cancer and their families: home visits by doctors, nurses and counsellors; day-care clinics; a helpline; bereavement support.
answers.bring: The patient's diagnosis and latest medical reports, and the address for home visits.
answers.where: Delhi NCR. Call the helpline to ask whether your area is covered.

answers.give: Material (clothes, household items, stationery, old newspapers, furniture, dry ration) at a Goonj centre or a volunteer-run dropping centre, or courier it to the nearest office. Money online at goonj.org/donate, or a cheque in the name of GOONJ to J-93, Sarita Vihar, New Delhi 110076.
answers.tax: Goonj is registered under 80G, 12A and FCRA. Money donations get an 80G receipt: send your name, PAN, amount, address and transfer details. Material donations get an acknowledgement but no tax exemption.
answers.activities: Sorting and packing at a Goonj centre, running collection drives in an office, colony or school, opening a dropping centre, and internships (at least 1 month, Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 5 pm, no stipend).
answers.shifts: Saturday sorting at the Sarita Vihar centre, Delhi: 10 am to 1 pm and 2 pm to 5 pm, 5 places each.

answers.ask_who: The People team: Priya Menon, people@tfi-handbook.test.

answers.asked_most: How to join as a volunteer, how a restaurant can give surplus food, and whether we take money (we don't: we're zero-funds).
